title: Causes of the 204,848 bottles of blood lost in the American Red Cross plasma programme, World War II
description: Bar chart of bottles of blood lost before or during processing, of 12,589,034 delivered to plasma processing laboratories in World War II: bacterial contamination 125,748; positive serology 28,364; miscellaneous 20,734; breakage in the centrifuge 17,048; hemolysis 7,567; clotting 3,727; breakage in transit 1,660. Data: Kendrick, Blood Program in World War II (1964), table 8, p. 306, from the final report of the American Red Cross.
heading: BOTTLES LOST, BY CAUSE (OF 12.6 MILLION)
